system.name: Wallet
system.one_liner: a confidential serverless computing system that runs functions in trusted processes inside a CVM, excluding the guest OS from the trust boundary

components.name: Trustlet1
components.role: sender trustlet that creates a data object and writes to it

components.name: Trustlet2
components.role: receiver trustlet that gets the data object and reads from it

components.name: Page table
components.role: per-trustlet page table updated to grant write or read access to the object

components.name: Object
components.role: shared data object in memory used for inter-function communication

components.name: Trusted Monitor
components.role: mediates object allocation and page-table updates to enforce isolation

flows.what: Updates PT to grant Trustlet1 write access
Updates PT to grant Trustlet2 read access

content.key_idea: Wallet lets two trustlets communicate through a shared-memory data object whose page-table permissions (write-only for the creator, read-only for the receiver) are granted only by the trusted monitor.
content.reading_order: Top-down and symmetric: Trustlet1 (left) calls createObject and writes, Trustlet2 (right) calls getObject and reads, with the Trusted Monitor below mediating both sides' page tables.

summary: This figure shows how two trustlets in Wallet communicate through a shared-memory data object, illustrating both the control path and the data path. Trustlet1 calls createObject() (step 1); the Trusted Monitor allocates the object in Memory (2) and updates Trustlet1's page table to grant write access (3). Trustlet2 then calls getObject() (4), and the monitor updates Trustlet2's page table to grant read access (5). With permissions set, Trustlet1 writes directly to the Object and Trustlet2 reads from it via the solid-line data path, while the dashed-line control path shows the API calls and page-table updates mediated by the Trusted Monitor. A red X between the two trustlets marks that the object itself is never directly accessible beyond each trustlet's granted permission, and the monitor limits each object to at most one writer and one reader.
summary_zh: 该图展示 Wallet 中两个可信小程序经共享内存对象通信：创建者调用 createObject 获写权限，接收者调用 getObject 获读权限，均由可信监控器更新页表，二者再直接读写该对象。
